findings.issue_category: missing bucket encryption and access controls
findings.description: This bucket has no server_side_encryption_configuration block, so objects are stored unencrypted at rest by default, and it also lacks an explicit ACL or public access block, leaving it potentially exposed to default/public access depending on account settings.

No versioning block is defined, meaning objects like the seeded vendor roster file can be overwritten or deleted without recovery, which combined with force_destroy increases risk of irreversible data loss and tampering.
This bucket stores financial ledger export data but has no server_side_encryption_configuration, so sensitive data is stored unencrypted at rest.
No versioning is enabled for ledger export data, and force_destroy is true, increasing the risk of accidental or malicious permanent data loss for financial records.

The bucket has no server_side_encryption_configuration, so model artifacts are stored unencrypted at rest, increasing exposure risk if the bucket is ever misconfigured for public access or accessed by unauthorized IAM principals.
No server_side_encryption_configuration is defined, so operational runbooks (which may contain sensitive infrastructure details) are stored unencrypted at rest.

The ACL value 'lcatalogopts-delivery-write' is not a valid S3 canned ACL; if Terraform coerces or this is intended to be 'log-delivery-write', it grants broad write/read-acp permissions to the S3 log delivery group, which combined with force_destroy and its role as an audit trail sink is a significant integrity risk for the audit log bucket.

force_destroy = true allows the bucket and all its contents to be deleted via Terraform without a recovery mechanism such as versioning, increasing risk of accidental or malicious permanent data loss.

The vendor roster spreadsheet is uploaded to a bucket (reports_archive) that lacks server-side encryption configuration and has no explicit private ACL or public access block, risking exposure of potentially sensitive vendor data.
